notes.subject: היו מכותם
notes.rationale: 'their wounds came suddenly' (JPS 'thence are their wounds') vs 'they were wounded' (KJV, verbal reading); dɛsɛw jateden-yɛrɛ ta ye nin na.

notes.subject: יֹרֵם / יֹרֻהוּ
notes.rationale: V8's 'Elohim shoots them' echoes V5's 'they shoot him' — the same verb ירה turns the enemies' weapon back on them; a bɛ Bamanankan na kelen-kelen bɛɛ ye faa ye.

translation: O kɔfɛ, Elohim ye bon faa u la tɔɔsira la; dɛsɛw sinna u kan kokura.

tokens.gloss: o kɔfɛ … ye faa u la
